accounts_complete_profile_username_warni: Your username can't be changed later
accounts_complete_profile_confirm: I understand and want to use this username.

accounts_complete_profile_continuation_i: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.

accounts_sign_in_password_help: Forgot your password? Contact your administrator.

accounts_sign_in_archived: This account is no longer active. Please contact support.

accounts_sign_in_link_invalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Start again from your workspace.
accounts_sign_in_unassigned: You don't belong to any workspace yet. Please contact your admin.
accounts_create_login_intro: Enter the person’s details and set their password.
accounts_create_login_username_help: Use 4–8 characters. Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, numbers, periods, underscores or hyphens.
accounts_create_login_password_help: Use 12–64 characters, including an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol. The password is kept exactly as entered.
accounts_create_login_password_invalid: Use 12–64 characters with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.
accounts_create_login_phone_help: Choose the country code and enter the phone number.
accounts_create_login_phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number for the selected country.
accounts_create_login_workspace_help: Prepared workspaces are shown in pages, newest first. The address distinguishes workspaces with the same name.
accounts_create_login_workspaces_failed: We could not load the workspace list. Retry the list or try the next page again.
accounts_create_login_kind_required: Choose an internal or external user.
accounts_create_login_pending: Keep this page open. Retry this same request to finish or confirm creation; the details stay fixed until it is complete.
accounts_create_login_session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in in a new tab, then retry this request.
accounts_create_login_sign_in: Sign in in a new tab
accounts_create_login_identity_changed: Your sign-in has changed. Reload this page before creating a login.
accounts_create_login_forbidden: You do not have permission to create this login. Contact your administrator.
accounts_create_login_profile_required: Complete your required profile details before creating a login.
accounts_create_login_not_ready: Your login is not ready to use yet. Contact your administrator.
accounts_create_login_conflict: This creation request cannot be completed with its saved details. Contact your administrator.
accounts_create_login_unknown_result: We could not confirm whether creation finished. Keep this page open and retry the same request.
accounts_create_login_success_details: {email} can sign in as {username} with the password you entered.
accounts_create_login_handover: Share the login details with the person through your usual channel.
accounts_create_login_page_error: We could not open the login-creation screen.
stms_reset_password_intro: Set a new password for {email}. This ends all current sessions for this login.
stms_reset_password_help: Use 12–64 characters, including an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol. The password is kept exactly as entered.
stms_reset_password_invalid: Use 12–64 characters with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.
stms_reset_password_saved_for: The password for {email} has been reset.
stms_reset_password_handover: Share the new password through your usual channel.
stms_reset_password_sign_in_tab: Sign in in a new tab
stms_reset_password_session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in as the same master in a new tab, then submit a new reset if needed.
stms_reset_password_identity_changed: Your sign-in has changed. Reload this page before resetting a password.
stms_reset_password_forbidden: Only an active master user may reset passwords.
stms_reset_password_profile_required: Complete your required profile details before resetting a password.
stms_reset_password_not_ready: Your login is not ready to use. Contact your administrator.
stms_reset_password_not_found: This login could not be found.
stms_reset_password_unknown: We could not confirm the reset. It may have completed. Check whether the new password works before resetting again; another submission makes a new reset.
stms_reset_password_self_unknown: This may already have ended your sessions. Try signing in with the password you entered.
stms_reset_password_comment_long: The submitted details are too long. Shorten the comment and submit again.
accounts_profile_identifiers_help: Email and username can only be changed by an xpro master user.
accounts_profile_phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number for the selected country.
accounts_profile_current_required: Enter your current password (up to 64 characters).
accounts_profile_password_invalid: Use 12–64 characters with an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol.
accounts_profile_password_help: Use 12–64 characters, including an uppercase letter, a number and a symbol. The password is kept exactly as entered.
accounts_profile_password_sessions: Changing your password signs you out on other devices. This browser stays signed in.
accounts_profile_password_saved: Your password has been changed. Your other sessions have ended.
accounts_profile_password_unknown: We could not confirm the change. Your new password may already be saved and your sessions may have ended. Keep this page open and sign in in a new tab to check whether your current or new password works before submitting again.
accounts_profile_picture_help: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP file, up to {maximumBytes} bytes. Crop it to a square before saving.
accounts_profile_picture_paused: Picture uploads are temporarily unavailable. You can still remove your current picture.
accounts_profile_picture_large: Choose a picture within the upload limit shown below.
accounts_profile_picture_type: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
accounts_profile_picture_invalid: This picture could not be read. Choose a valid JPG, PNG or WebP file.
accounts_profile_picture_changed: Your picture changed in another request. Check the saved picture before trying again.
accounts_profile_picture_unknown: The picture may have been saved. Check the saved picture before submitting again.
accounts_profile_crop_help: Drag the square or use the arrow keys to move it. Use the corner handles to resize it.
accounts_profile_crop_nw: Resize crop from the top start corner
accounts_profile_crop_ne: Resize crop from the top end corner
accounts_profile_crop_se: Resize crop from the bottom end corner
accounts_profile_crop_sw: Resize crop from the bottom start corner
accounts_profile_identity_changed: Your sign-in has changed. Reload this page before saving changes.
accounts_profile_incomplete: Complete your required profile details in a new tab before continuing.
accounts_profile_forbidden: You do not have access to this profile. Contact your administrator.
accounts_profile_draft_kept: Your unsaved changes are kept on this page. Nothing will be submitted automatically.

stms_logins_search: Search by name, email or username
stms_logins_table_caption: Logins are ordered by creation time, newest first.
stms_logins_empty: There are no logins to show.
stms_logins_email_help: Changing the email signs this person out on all devices.

stms_logins_username_invalid: Use a valid 4–8 character username in the format shown.

stms_logins_too_long: The submitted details are too long. Shorten the comment and submit again.

stms_logins_archive_warning: Archive {email}? All their sessions will end and the login will leave the normal list. Keep this page’s link if you need to restore it later.
stms_logins_other_comment_required: Explain the reason when choosing Other.
stms_logins_suspended_saved: Login suspended. All their sessions have ended.
stms_logins_reactivated_saved: Login reactivated. The existing password still works.
stms_logins_archived_saved: Login archived. Keep this link to restore it later.
stms_logins_restored_saved: Login restored to its previous status.
stms_logins_state_changed: This login’s status changed. Check the current details before making another change.
stms_logins_not_found: This login could not be found.
stms_logins_unknown: We could not confirm the change. It may have completed. Check the saved details before making another change.
stms_logins_forbidden: Only xpro master users can manage global logins.
stms_logins_identity_changed: Your sign-in has changed. Reload this page before making changes.
stms_logins_profile_required: Complete your required profile details before managing logins.

accounts_mfa_setup_intro: Master logins need an authenticator app. Enter your current password to begin setup.
accounts_mfa_scan_intro: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or add an account using the setup key below. Then enter the six-digit code shown by your app.
accounts_mfa_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.
accounts_mfa_pending_intro: A setup is already waiting. If you added its key to your authenticator app, enter its code. If you no longer have the key, restart setup.
accounts_mfa_authenticator_intro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
accounts_mfa_backup_intro: Enter one of your unused backup codes. Each code works once.
accounts_mfa_restart_warning: Your previous setup key and backup codes will stop working. Enter your current password to replace the pending setup.
accounts_mfa_backups_help: Keep these codes somewhere private. Each code can replace your authenticator code once. This display is lost when you leave or refresh. Continue when you are ready.
accounts_mfa_download_started: Download started. Keep the file private.
accounts_mfa_download_failed: Could not download. Copy the codes or select the text to save them.
accounts_mfa_code_format: Enter the six digits shown by your authenticator app.
accounts_mfa_code_invalid: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
accounts_mfa_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
accounts_mfa_unavailable: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
accounts_mfa_already_pending: A setup is already waiting. Reload this page to verify it or explicitly restart setup.
accounts_mfa_expired: This sign-in has ended. Start again with your email or username and password.
accounts_mfa_identity_changed: The signed-in login changed. Private setup details have been cleared. Start again for the current login.
accounts_mfa_access_lost: This login can no longer complete this action. Private setup details have been cleared. Start again.
accounts_mfa_uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Reload to check the current setup before trying the action again.
accounts_mfa_setup_changed: Setup changed in another tab. The previous details have been cleared. Reload to check the current setup.
accounts_mfa_recent_required: For this change, sign in again with your password and an authenticator or backup code. Then return here and choose Check access and continue. Your form stays here.
accounts_mfa_generate_warning: Generating a new set makes all previous backup codes stop working. Your authenticator will keep working.
accounts_mfa_replace_warning: This signs out your other devices and replaces your current authenticator and backup codes. You will need to finish the new setup before you can continue using xpro.
accounts_mfa_backups_uncertain: The set may have changed even though the reply failed. Check access before explicitly generating another set. Existing codes cannot be retrieved from this page.
accounts_mfa_lost_codes: Your authenticator is ready. This page no longer has your backup codes. You can generate a new set in Profile after completing any required profile details.
accounts_mfa_profile_tab: Open Profile in a new tab
